name: net_late_loader_resyncs_behind
description: Three clients; client 3 is still building its hollow when the sequencer starts without it. START before its LOADED tells it so: it says VISIBILITY catching_up and steps nothing, while its seat is AWAY from turn 0 and the caretaker builds for it. Past the second checkpoint its LOADED goes out: the sequencer answers RESYNC(behind) from its latest kept checkpoint, not tick 0. Client 3 sends no HASH while it runs the turns it held from tick 0 (they would reach the server below the checkpoint the RESYNC counts from), loads the checkpoint, catches up with a moving bar, says shown, which brings it BACK, and the next build window hands its seat back. Every hash agrees from the checkpoint on.

steps.assert: scene.client(3).started_without and not scene.client(3).loaded_sent and scene.client(3).said_visibility == 2
steps.msg: START came before its LOADED: it knows the match started without it, and says catching_up
its seat is AWAY from turn 0
two checkpoints kept, and the late client has stepped nothing yet
the caretaker built for the seat meanwhile

steps.assert: resynced and resync[1] == 2 and resync[2] == 'behind' and resync[3] == scene.seq.checkpoint_ticks[-1] and resync[3] > 0
steps.msg: its LOADED brought RESYNC(behind) from the latest kept checkpoint

steps.assert: scene.client(3).resyncs[0][0] == 'behind' and scene.client(3).resyncs[0][1] == resync[3] and scene.client(3).catching_up
steps.msg: it loaded that checkpoint and catches up, orders waiting

steps.assert: caught_up and scene.went_through(3, ['CATCHING_UP', 'NONE']) and scene.bars_seen[2].size() >= 10 and scene.bars_seen[2].max() == 1000
steps.msg: the overlay said catching up with a moving bar, then nothing
shown brought it BACK, and the next build window handed the seat back

steps.assert: scene.sent_hashes_agree_from(resync[3]) and scene.seq.disagreements.is_empty() and abs(scene.tick(3) - scene.tick(1)) <= 30
steps.msg: every hash agrees from the checkpoint on, client 3 level with the others

steps.assert: scene.client(3).hashes_sent >= 5 and scene.client(3).sent_hashes.keys().min() > resync[3] and scene.client(3).phase_name() == 'IN_MATCH'
steps.msg: it never sent a HASH from before the checkpoint, and its link stands
